independent_conclusion.numeric_slot_rule: After the solvent/formula, count six property slots in order: (1) melting point, (2) boiling point, (3) viscosity, (4) dielectric constant, (5) ionic conductivity, (6) flash point. Missing cells are represented by blanks, a slash, or by text extraction on adjacent lines.
independent_conclusion.caveat: 编号 51 的 dielectric 单元格在 PDF 中垂直堆叠了两个数：36.00（上值，行引文 [36] 所对应的主值）和 25.00（下层附加/未单独标注值）。编号 43 只有 36.00。因此按主文献值比较两次一致；若把同一单元格的全部堆叠值都视为候选，则编号 51 是一个多值单元格。

mopn_shift_test.two_columns_left: boiling-point cell: measured blank; predicted 142.47 on continuation line 5314
mopn_shift_test.rejection: 1.10 is the viscosity entry; the ionic-conductivity cell is /; 142.47 is a boiling-point-scale value; 66.00 is the flash-point value in °C.

2.50 is the viscosity entry; the right neighboring conductivity cell is /; 164.00 is boiling point; 66.00 is flash point. 25.00 is not an adjacent column: PDF coordinates put it below 36.00 inside the dielectric cell.

counterfactual_checks.conclusion: The one-column-left candidates are viscosity values and the one-column-right candidate is the missing conductivity cell (not a number). These are excluded both by header placement and by independently known property magnitudes. The only numerically plausible alternatives are 25.00, which is a lower stacked value in the same dielectric cell, and 66.00, which is two columns right and matches the flash point.

conclusions.numerical_facts_for_dataset: Generally usable as extracted factual data with attribution and provenance, but this is distinct from a blanket right to copy the SI/table expression or compilation in bulk.
conclusions.si_file_redistribution: No redistribution permission can be assumed from the available evidence. The paper is marked closed, the SI has no stated CC license, and the metadata points to Wiley terms.

prior_conclusion_comparison.agreement: Agrees on MOPN primary dielectric value 36.00 at 25 °C, on tetraglyme absence, and on closed/no-CC license status.
differences_and_additions: The prior report documents row 51 as the MOPN hit; this adversarial check additionally documents row 43 and shows that its primary dielectric value is also 36.00.
The prior report treats 25.00 as an unlabeled stacked value under the dielectric column; this check independently confirms the stacked geometry from PDF word coordinates.
The prior report does not provide a three-compound column-order reconstruction or an explicit one-column-left/right counterfactual; those are added here.
No numerical or licensing contradiction was found.
